title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30442: allow filtering item units during weight updates
summary: Extensions can now filter item units of measure during weight recalculation by subscribing to a new integration event that fires before the calculation begins.
key_points: New integration event OnUpdateItemUnitOfMeasureWeightOnBeforeCalcWeight added to Item table
Event fires before weight recalculation to allow subscribers to adjust the item-unit filter
Enables exclusion of selected units including the base unit from weight updates
Event propagated across all regional layers (W1, NA, GB, CH, ES, IT, APAC, RU)
quote: Extensions need to exclude selected item units of measure, including the base unit, when recalculating weights from the item's net weight.
